column1: SUB-005
column9: one token span + the mutable cc->symbol_table
column11: The decision calls cctrlIsKeyword(cc,tok->start,tok->len), which resolves through cctrlGetKeyWord(cc,...) into the MUTABLE cc->symbol_table. The transitive dependence is source-bound and MEASURED in c1/host-state-and-recovery-dependencies.tsv. The projection is therefore NOT bounded.

column1: SUB-006
column11: The per-statement recovery checkpoint hoists the jmp_buf into the function frame and writes the current recovery state. It OWNS setjmp and WRITES the recovery state. This is a whole-region property, not a bounded scalar decision.

column1: SUB-007
column11: The compound statement body loop reads and writes the current recovery state across iterations and drives the whole host AST list append. It REQUIRES nonlocal recovery and performs host graph writes.

column1: SUB-008
column11: The WHOLE-FUNCTION parseStatement. It owns the recovery checkpoint, drives the token cursor, constructs the host AST and calls the parser callbacks. Whole-function ineligibility does NOT conceal SUB-004, which is a bounded independent sub-decision.

column1: SUB-009
column11: The WHOLE-FUNCTION parseExpr. It is a recursive descent loop over the token cursor that builds the host AST and owns the recovery state. It is a whole-function blocker, not a bounded scalar decision.

column1: SUB-010
column11: The recursive flow walk over a host AST node. It reads the node graph and recurses over the host AST children. A whole-function blocker.

column1: # THE SUB-001..SUB-012 RECONCILIATION AGAINST THE LIVE SOURCE
# All twelve historical structural IDs are present and classified.  Each
# range was MEASURED from the live bytes with MODE=RANGE.  No ID was
# invented and no ID was dropped.
# The SUB-006 and SUB-007 ranges are the LIVE, MEASURED regions:
#   SUB-006  2043..2076  the jmp_buf declaration, the cc->current_recovery
#                         save/overwrite and the setjmp(stmt_recovery)
#                         handler block, INCLUDING the localenv restore and
#                         the body->stms / cc->tmp_locals list splicing.
#   SUB-007  2077..2186  the compound statement body loop, ending with
#                         listAppend(body->stms,stmt) and the recovery
#                         restore cc->current_recovery = outer_recovery.
# SUB-001, SUB-008, SUB-009, SUB-010, SUB-011 and SUB-012 use the live
# whole-function ranges (the census body_line convention, which includes
# each function's own trailing comment block).
# THE CLASS PARTITION
#   ALREADY_SELFHOSTED     = 2   (SUB-001, SUB-003)
#   STRUCTURAL_BOUNDARY    = 2   (SUB-002, SUB-004)
#   INELIGIBLE_STRUCTURAL  = 8   (SUB-005 .. SUB-012)
#   TOTAL SUB-SLICES       = 12
#   UNCLASSIFIED_SUBSLICES = 0
# SUB-001 and SUB-003 are EXCLUDED as remaining legacy-C authorities,
# and their production PolyC owners are PRESERVED (AC17).
# SUB-002, SUB-004, SUB-005 and SUB-006..SUB-012 are re-evaluated from
# the CURRENT source.  SUB-002 and SUB-004 are the two surviving
# structural boundaries; their causal feasibility is NOT assumed here and
# is measured in C2 by a real compiler mutation.
# WHOLE-FUNCTION BLOCKERS DISPOSITIONED (the PARSER01 obligations)
#   parseCompoundStatementInternal -- the recovery checkpoint (SUB-006),
#     the compound body loop (SUB-007), and the enclosing whole function.
#     Graph ownership: the body list append (listAppend(body->stms,...)).
#     Callbacks: parseStatement.  Diagnostics: cctrlRaiseException.
#     Recovery: OWNS the jmp_buf (setjmp at 2063) and WRITES
#     cc->current_recovery (2045, 2189).  Token cursor: cctrlTokenPeek/Get.
#     Mutable table: cc->localenv, cc->tmp_locals, cc->symbol_table.
#     Feasibility: NOT migratable as a bounded ABI.
#   parseStatement -- the whole-function parser (SUB-008).  Graph
#     ownership: every Ast node it returns.  Callbacks: the statement
#     constructors (parseIfStatement, parseForStatement, ... 14 of them).
#     Diagnostics: cctrlRaiseException.  Recovery: owned by the
#     enclosing compound block.  Token cursor: consumed here.
#     Feasibility: the WHOLE function is not migratable, but its bounded
#     KEYWORD DISPATCH sub-decision (SUB-004, 1773..1786) IS
#     independently bounded and is NOT concealed by this blocker.
#   parseExpr -- the whole-expression loop (SUB-009).  Graph ownership:
#     the expression AST.  Callbacks: parseUnaryExpr and the binary-op
#     constructors.  Diagnostics: cctrlRaiseSuggestion/Exception.
#     Recovery: owned by the enclosing compound block.  Token cursor:
#     consumed here.  Feasibility: not migratable as a whole.
#   RECURSIVE FLOW WALKS (SUB-010, SUB-011, SUB-012) -- astStmtFallsThrough,
#     astStmtHasBreak and astIsConstTrueCond.  These RECURSE over the
#     host AST child graph.  Whole-function blockers.  Note that the
#     scalar decisions they CONSUME (the AST_BIN_OP classifiers
#     CAND-025/026/036/037) are independently bounded and are NOT
#     concealed by this blocker.
# NO SUB-DECISION IS CONCEALED BY A WHOLE-FUNCTION BLOCKER.  Every
# bounded sub-decision that survives is listed as its own candidate ID.
